title: Osmotic Coefficients of Aqueous CaCl2 Solutions from 3 to 12 m at 50 C
authors: Lisa M. Duckett, Jeffrey M. Hollifield, C. Stuart Patterson
experimental_method: Isopiestic comparison of CaCl2(aq) with LiCl(aq) reference at 50 C using the apparatus of Humphries et al. with modifications of Davis et al.
uncertainties_stated: Experimental uncertainty about 0.05%; per-row coefficient of variation of replicate samples is tabulated (0.00-0.10 %).
quality_remarks: Osmotic coefficients derived from literature LiCl data (Gibbard and Scatchard); authors note reliability above 3 m is limited by accuracy of those data. Temperature scale not stated. Footnote letters a,b,c in Table I belong to the headers m, n, cv and were stripped from the headers.
needs_pass2_reason: Text layer was clean and every cell matched the page image.
not_extracted_tables: Table II: parameters of empirical fits of R and phi (model parameters)
Table III: smoothed CaCl2 osmotic coefficients at rounded molalities with literature comparison (smoothed/fitted, derived)
extraction_notes: Sanity: both molality columns increase monotonically; CaCl2/LiCl ratio smooth.
